column3: Close to the Hebrew.
“Some of the end of the vessels” is rendered “some of the vessels”; NASB renders “the house of the treasury” as “the treasury.”
“People of Israel” is rendered “sons of Israel”; NASB adds “including.”
“Blemish” is rendered “defect,” and “to stand in the palace” “for serving in the king’s court”; NASB adds “he ordered him.”
“The matter of a day in its day” is rendered “a daily ration,” “to bring them up” “educated,” and “stand before the king” “enter the king’s personal service.”
“People of Judah” is rendered “sons of Judah.”
NASB adds “new” and “the name.”
“Set on his heart” is rendered “made up his mind,” and “requested” “sought permission.”
“Gave Daniel to favor and compassion” is rendered “granted Daniel favor and compassion.”
“Looking thin” is rendered “looking more haggard,” and “endanger my head” “make me forfeit my head.”
“Guardian” is rendered “overseer.”
“Let people give to us” is rendered with a passive, “let us be given.”
“Let our appearance appear before you” is rendered “let our appearance be observed in your presence.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Good and fat of flesh” is rendered “better and they were fatter.”
NASB adds “continued to” and renders “taking away” as “withhold.”
“Every vision and dreams” is rendered “all kinds of visions and dreams”; NASB adds “even.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Stood before the king” is rendered “entered the king’s personal service.”
“Ten hands” is rendered “ten times better,” and “soothsayer-priests” “magicians.”
“Was” is rendered “continued.”
